E01-SCH: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flghf WHERE hub_kz = 1

E02-VAG: SELECT ort FROM flghf WHERE nachtflugverb_kz = 1

E03-SCH: SELECT bez FROM flges WHERE allianz = 'CargoLink' ORDER BY bez

E04-SCH: SELECT mdl FROM lfz_typ WHERE herst = 'Airbus'

E05-SCH: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lfz WHERE eigt_art = 'leased'

E05-VAG: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lfz WHERE eigt_art = 'leased'

E06-SCH: SELECT kennz, stat FROM lfz WHERE stat != 'active'
E06-BIZ: SELECT kennz, stat FROM lfz WHERE stat IN ('maintenance', 'retired')
E06-VAG: SELECT kennz FROM lfz WHERE stat = 'active'
E07-CAS: SELECT treue_stufe, COUNT(*) FROM knd_stamm GROUP BY treue_stufe
E07-SCH: SELECT treue_stufe, COUNT(*) FROM knd_stamm GROUP BY treue_stufe
E07-BIZ: SELECT treue_stufe, COUNT(kunnr) AS headcount FROM knd_stamm GROUP BY treue_stufe
E07-VAG: SELECT treue_stufe, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM knd_stamm GROUP BY treue_stufe
E08-CAS: SELECT name1, ort FROM knd_stamm WHERE land = 'Germany'
E08-SCH: SELECT name1, ort FROM knd_stamm WHERE land = 'Germany'
E08-BIZ: SELECT name1, ort FROM knd_stamm WHERE land = 'Germany'
E08-VAG: SELECT kunnr, name1, ort, strasse, plz, ansprechp, ansp_mail, ansp_tel, web_adr, vertr_reg, kredlim_usd, zahlbed_tg, bek_versender_kz, treue_stufe, erdat FROM knd_stamm WHERE land = 'Germany'
E09-CAS: SELECT lgr_typ, COUNT(*) FROM lgr GROUP BY lgr_typ
E09-SCH: SELECT lgr_typ, COUNT(*) FROM lgr GROUP BY lgr_typ
E09-BIZ: SELECT lgr_typ, COUNT(*) AS warehouse_count FROM lgr GROUP BY lgr_typ
E09-VAG: SELECT lgr_typ, COUNT(*) AS warehouse_count FROM lgr GROUP BY lgr_typ
E10-CAS: SELECT SUM(flaeche_m2) AS total_cold_chain_space FROM lgr WHERE lgr_typ = 'cold_chain'
E10-SCH: SELECT SUM(flaeche_m2) FROM lgr WHERE lgr_typ = 'cold_chain'
E10-BIZ: SELECT SUM(flaeche_m2) AS total_cold_chain_footprint FROM lgr WHERE lgr_typ = 'cold_chain'
E10-VAG: SELECT SUM(flaeche_m2) AS total_cold_chain_space FROM lgr WHERE lgr_typ = 'cold_chain'
M01-CAS: SELECT flgesbez, COUNT(lfz_nr) AS plane_count FROM flges JOIN lfz ON flges.flges_nr = lfz.flges_nr GROUP BY flgesbez ORDER BY plane_count DESC
M01-SCH: SELECT flges.bez, COUNT(lfz.flges_nr) AS aircraft_count FROM flges LEFT JOIN lfz ON flges.flges_nr = lfz.flges_nr GROUP BY flges.bez ORDER BY aircraft_count DESC, flges.bez
M01-BIZ: SELECT flgesbez, COUNT(lfz_nr) AS fleet_size FROM flges JOIN lfz ON flges.flges_nr = lfz.flges_nr GROUP BY flgesbez ORDER BY fleet_size DESC
M01-VAG: SELECT flgesbez, COUNT(lfz_nr) AS aircraft_count FROM flges JOIN lfz ON flges.flges_nr = lfz.flges_nr GROUP BY flgesbez
M02-CAS: SELECT lfz_typ.mdl, COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) AS active_planes FROM lfz JOIN lfz_typ ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr WHERE lfz.stat = 'active' GROUP BY lfz_typ.mdl
M02-SCH: SELECT lfz_typ.mdl, COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) AS active_count FROM lfz JOIN lfz_typ ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr WHERE lfz.stat = 'active' GROUP BY lfz_typ.mdl ORDER BY lfz_typ.mdl
M02-BIZ: SELECT lfz_typ.mdl, COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) AS active_count FROM lfz JOIN lfz_typ ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr WHERE lfz.stat = 'active' GROUP BY lfz_typ.mdl
M02-VAG: SELECT lfz_typ.mdl, COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) AS active_planes FROM lfz JOIN lfz_typ ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr WHERE lfz.stat = 'active' GROUP BY lfz_typ.mdl
M03-CAS: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flug WHERE abfl_ist IS NOT NULL AND abfl_fh = (SELECT fh_nr FROM flghf WHERE iata_cd = 'IST')
M03-SCH: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flug WHERE stat = 'completed' AND abfl_fh = (SELECT fh_nr FROM flghf WHERE iata_cd = 'IST')
M03-BIZ: SELECT SUM(entf_km) AS completed_departure_volume FROM flug WHERE abfl_ist IS NOT NULL AND abfl_fh = (SELECT fh_nr FROM flghf WHERE iata_cd = 'IST') AND stat = 'completed'
M03-VAG: SELECT COUNT(*) AS busy_level FROM flug WHERE abfl_fh = (SELECT fh_nr FROM flghf WHERE iata_cd = 'IST')
M04-CAS: SELECT flghf1.bez AS from_airport, flghf2.bez AS to_airport, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM flug JOIN flghf flghf1 ON flug.abfl_fh = flghf1(fh_nr) JOIN flghf flghf2 ON flug.ziel_fh = flghf2(fh_nr) WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY flghf1.bez, flghf2.bez ORDER BY flight_count DESC LIMIT 5
M04-SCH: SELECT f1.ort, f2.ort, COUNT(f1.flug_id) AS completed_flights FROM flug f1 JOIN flghf f2 ON f1.urspr_fh = f2(fh_nr) JOIN flghf f3 ON f1.ziel_fh = f3(fh_nr) WHERE f1.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY f1.ort, f2.ort ORDER BY completed_flights DESC LIMIT 5
M04-BIZ: SELECT lgr.lgr_cd, COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS completed_flights FROM lgr JOIN flug_ladg ON lgr.lgr_nr = flug_ladg.lgr_nr JOIN flug ON flug_ladg.flug_id = flug.flug_id WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY lgr.lgr_cd ORDER BY completed_flights DESC LIMIT 5
M04-VAG: SELECT flghf.bez AS departure, flghf2.bez AS arrival, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM flug JOIN flghf ON flug.abfl_fh = flghf(fh_nr) JOIN flghf AS flghf2 ON flug.ziel_fh = flghf2(fh_nr) GROUP BY flug.abfl_fh, flug.ziel_fh ORDER BY flight_count DESC LIMIT 10
M05-CAS: SELECT AVG(CAST(SUBSTR(ank_ist, 12, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTR(ank_ist, 15, 2) AS INTEGER) - CAST(SUBSTR(ank_plan, 12, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 - CAST(SUBSTR(ank_plan, 15, 2) AS INTEGER)) AS avg_late_minutes FROM flug WHERE stat = 'completed'
M05-SCH: SELECT AVG((strftime('%s', T1.ank_ist) - strftime('%s', T1.ank_plan)) / 60) AS avg_delay, T2.bez FROM flug AS T1 JOIN flghf AS T2 ON T1.ziel_fh = T2(fh_nr) WHERE T1.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY T2.bez ORDER BY avg_delay DESC LIMIT 1
M05-BIZ: SELECT flgesbez, AVG(CAST(REPLACE(SUBSTR(ank_ist, 12, 8), ':', '') AS INTEGER) - CAST(REPLACE(SUBSTR(ank_plan, 12, 8), ':', '') AS INTEGER)) AS avg_delay FROM flug JOIN flges ON flug.flges_nr = flges.flges_nr WHERE ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND ank_plan IS NOT NULL GROUP BY flgesbez
M05-VAG: SELECT bez FROM flges ORDER BY gruend_jahr DESC LIMIT 1
M06-CAS: SELECT flgesbez, COUNT(*) AS cancelled_flights FROM flges JOIN flug ON flges.flges_nr = flug.flges_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'cancelled' GROUP BY flgesbez
M06-SCH: SELECT flghf.bez, COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS cancelled_flights FROM flug JOIN lfz ON flug.lfz_nr = lfz.lfz_nr JOIN flghf ON lfz.heimat_fh_nr = flghf(fh_nr) WHERE flug.stat = 'cancelled' GROUP BY flghf.bez ORDER BY cancelled_flights DESC
M06-BIZ: SELECT flgesbez, COUNT(*) AS cancellation_volume FROM flges JOIN flug ON flges.flges_nr = flug.flges_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'cancelled' GROUP BY flgesbez
M06-VAG: SELECT flgesbez, COUNT(*) AS cancellation_count FROM flges JOIN flug ON flges.flges_nr = flug.flges_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'cancelled' GROUP BY flgesbez
M07-CAS: SELECT flgesbez, SUM(co2_kg) AS total_co2 FROM flges JOIN flug ON flges.flges_nr = flug.flges_nr GROUP BY flgesbez
M07-SCH: SELECT flges.bez, ROUND(SUM(betankg.co2_kg / 1000), 1) AS avg_co2_kg FROM betankg JOIN flug ON betankg.flug_id = flug.flug_id JOIN lfz ON betankg.lfz_nr = lfz.lfz_nr JOIN flges ON lfz.flges_nr = flges.flges_nr GROUP BY flges.bez
M07-BIZ: SELECT flgesbez, SUM(COALESCE(betankg.co2_kg, 0)) AS total_co2 FROM flges LEFT JOIN lfz ON flges.flges_nr = lfz.flges_nr LEFT JOIN betankg ON lfz.lfz_nr = betankg.lfz_nr GROUP BY flgesbez
M07-VAG: SELECT flgesbez, SUM(co2_kg) AS total_co2_emissions FROM flges JOIN flug ON flges.flges_nr = flug.flges_nr GROUP BY flgesbez ORDER BY total_co2_emissions DESC
M08-CAS: SELECT flghf.reg, AVG(betankg.preis_usd_l) AS avg_fuel_price_per_litre FROM flug_ladg JOIN flug ON flug_ladg.flug_id = flug.flug_id JOIN betankg ON flug_ladg.flug_id = betankg.flug_id JOIN flghf ON flug.abfl_fh = flghf(fh_nr) GROUP BY flghf.reg
M08-SCH: SELECT AVG(preis_usd_l), reg FROM betankg JOIN flghf ON betankg.fh_nr = flghf.fh_nr GROUP BY reg
M08-BIZ: SELECT flghf.reg, AVG(betankg.preis_usd_l) AS avg_fuel_price_per_liter FROM flug JOIN betankg ON flug.flug_id = betankg.flug_id JOIN flghf ON flug.urspr_fh = flghf(fh_nr) GROUP BY flghf.reg
M08-VAG: SELECT fh_nr, AVG(preis_usd_l) AS avg_fuel_price FROM betankg GROUP BY fh_nr ORDER BY avg_fuel_price DESC LIMIT 1
M09-CAS: SELECT lgr.fh_nr, flghf.bez, COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) AS warehouse_count FROM lgr JOIN flghf ON lgr.fh_nr = flghf(fh_nr) GROUP BY lgr.fh_nr, flghf.bez HAVING warehouse_count >= 4
M09-SCH: SELECT flghf.iata_cd, COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) AS lgr_count FROM flghf JOIN lgr ON flghf.fh_nr = lgr.fh_nr GROUP BY flghf.iata_cd HAVING lgr_count >= 4
M09-BIZ: SELECT ort FROM lgr GROUP BY ort HAVING COUNT(lgr_nr) >= 4
M09-VAG: SELECT f.bez, COUNT(l.lgr_nr) AS warehouse_count FROM flghf f JOIN lgr l ON f.fh_nr = l.fh_nr GROUP BY f.fh_nr ORDER BY warehouse_count DESC LIMIT 10
M10-CAS: SELECT flghf.ort, flghfbez FROM flghf JOIN lgr ON flghf.fh_nr = lgr.fh_nr WHERE lgr.zolllager_kz = 1 GROUP BY flghf.ort, flghfbez HAVING COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) > 1
M10-SCH: SELECT lgr.lgr_cd, COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) AS zoll_count FROM lgr JOIN flghf ON lgr.fh_nr = flghf.fh_nr WHERE lgr.zolllager_kz = 1 GROUP BY lgr.lgr_cd HAVING zoll_count > 1
M10-BIZ: SELECT lgr_nr, COUNT(*) AS bonded_count FROM lgr WHERE zolllager_kz = 1 GROUP BY lgr_nr HAVING bonded_count > 1
M10-VAG: SELECT flghf.ort, flghfbez, COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) AS bonded_warehouses FROM flghf JOIN lgr ON flghf.fh_nr = lgr.fh_nr WHERE lgr.zolllager_kz = 1 GROUP BY flghf.ort, flghfbez HAVING COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) > 1
H01-CAS: SELECT flgesbez, MAX(completed_flights) AS most_completed_flights FROM ( SELECT flgesbez, COUNT(*) AS completed_flights FROM flges JOIN lfz ON flges.flges_nr = lfz.flges_nr JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY flgesbez ) ORDER BY most_completed_flights DESC LIMIT 1
H01-SCH: SELECT bez, kennz, COUNT(*) AS flug_count FROM flug JOIN lfz ON flug.lfz_nr = lfz.lfz_nr WHERE stat = 'completed' GROUP BY bez, kennz ORDER BY flug_count DESC, kennz ASC LIMIT 1
H01-BIZ: SELECT flgesbez, lfznr, COUNT(*) as completed_flights FROM flges JOIN lfz ON flges.flgesnr = lfz.flgesnr JOIN flug ON lfz.lfznr = flug.lfznr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY flgesbez, lfznr ORDER BY completed_flights DESC
H01-VAG: SELECT flgesbez, lfznr, MAX(gesflugstd) AS busiest_flights FROM flges JOIN lfz ON flges.flgesnr = lfz.flgesnr GROUP BY flgesbez, lfznr ORDER BY busiest_flights DESC LIMIT 1
H02-CAS: SELECT flghf.ort, flges.bez, COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS landungen FROM flug JOIN flghf ON flug.abfl_fh = flghf(fh_nr) JOIN flges ON flug.flges_nr = flges.flges_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY flghf.ort, flges.bez ORDER BY flghf.ort, landungen DESC
H02-SCH: SELECT flghf.iata_cd, flghf.bez, COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS count FROM flug JOIN flghf ON flug.ziel_fh = flghf(fh_nr) WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY flghf.iata_cd, flghf.bez ORDER BY count DESC, flges.bez LIMIT 1
H02-BIZ: SELECT flghf.ort, flges.bez, COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS completed_arrivals FROM flug JOIN flghf ON flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank_ist <> '' AND flug.ziel_fh = flghf(fh_nr) JOIN flges ON flug.flges_nr = flges.flges_nr GROUP BY flghf.ort, flges.bez ORDER BY flghf.ort, completed_arrivals DESC
H02-VAG: SELECT flghf.ort, flges.bez, COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS flight_count FROM flghf JOIN flug ON flghf.fh_nr = flug.abfl_fh JOIN flges ON flug.flges_nr = flges.flges_nr GROUP BY flghf.ort, flges.bez ORDER BY flight_count DESC LIMIT 1
H03-CAS: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', ausst_dat) AS month, SUM(brutto_usd) AS invoice_amount, SUM(SUM(brutto_usd)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', ausst_dat)) AS running_total FROM rech_kopf WHERE strftime('%Y', ausst_dat) = '2025' GROUP BY month
H03-SCH: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', ausst_dat) AS month, SUM(brutto_usd) AS total_brutto_usd, SUM(SUM(brutto_usd)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', ausst_dat)) AS running_total_brutto_usd FROM rech_kopf WHERE strftime('%Y', ausst_dat) = '2025' GROUP BY month
H03-BIZ: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', rech_kopf.ausst_dat) AS month, SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) AS billed_revenue, SUM(SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', rech_kopf.ausst_dat)) AS ytd_cumulative FROM rech_kopf WHERE strftime('%Y', rech_kopf.ausst_dat) = '2025' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
H03-VAG: SELECT SUM(fracht_usd) AS total_revenue FROM rech_kopf WHERE ausst_dat BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'
H04-CAS: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', flug.ank_ist) AS month, COUNT(*) AS flights_completed, LAG(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', flug.ank_ist)) - COUNT(*) AS change FROM flug WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', flug.ank_ist) ORDER BY month
H04-SCH: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', abfl_ist) AS month, COUNT(*) AS completed_flights, LAG(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', abfl_ist)) - COUNT(*) AS diff_to_previous_month FROM flug WHERE stat = 'completed' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', abfl_ist) ORDER BY month
H04-BIZ: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', flug.abfl_ist) AS month, COUNT(*) AS completed_flights, LAG(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', flug.abfl_ist)) - COUNT(*) AS month_over_month_change FROM flug WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', flug.abfl_ist) ORDER BY month
H04-VAG: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', flug.abfl_plan) AS month, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM flug WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
H05-CAS: SELECT lfz.kennz, AVG(SUBSTR(flg.ank_ist, 1, 10) - SUBSTR(flg.abfl_ist, 1, 10)) AS avg_ground_time FROM lfz JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY lfz.kennz ORDER BY avg_ground_time ASC LIMIT 5
H05-SCH: SELECT lfz.kennz, AVG((julianday(flg.abfl_ist) - julianday(flg.ank_ist)) * 24) AS avg_time_diff FROM lfz JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY lfz.kennz ORDER BY avg_time_diff ASC LIMIT 5
H05-BIZ: SELECT lfz.kennz, AVG(julianday(flg.ank_ist) - julianday(flg.abfl_ist)) AS avg_turnaround FROM lfz JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY lfz.kennz ORDER BY avg_turnaround ASC LIMIT 5
H05-VAG: SELECT flug_id, abfl_ist, ank_ist, strftime('%J', ank_ist) - strftime('%J', abfl_ist) AS turnaround_days FROM flug WHERE stat = 'completed' ORDER BY turnaround_days ASC LIMIT 10
H06-CAS: SELECT kunnr, SUM(brutto_usd) AS total_invoiced, (SUM(brutto_usd) / (SELECT SUM(brutto_usd) FROM rech_kopf)) * 100 AS share FROM rech_kopf GROUP BY kunnr HAVING total_invoiced > (SELECT SUM(brutto_usd) * 0.04 FROM rech_kopf)
H06-SCH: SELECT knd_stamm.name1, SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) / ( SELECT SUM(brutto_usd) FROM rech_kopf ) AS avg_brutto_usd FROM sndg JOIN knd_stamm ON sndg.kunnr = knd_stamm.kunnr JOIN rech_kopf ON sndg.sndg_nr = rech_kopf.sndg_nr GROUP BY knd_stamm.name1 HAVING avg_brutto_usd > 0.04
H06-BIZ: SELECT kunnr, SUM(brutto_usd) AS revenue, SUM(brutto_usd) * 100 / (SELECT SUM(brutto_usd) FROM rech_kopf) AS share FROM rech_kopf GROUP BY kunnr HAVING SUM(brutto_usd) * 100 / (SELECT SUM(brutto_usd) FROM rech_kopf) > 4
H06-VAG: SELECT knd_stamm.name1, SUM(rech_kopf.fracht_usd) AS total_revenue FROM knd_stamm JOIN sndg ON knd_stamm.kunnr = sndg.kunnr JOIN rech_kopf ON sndg.sndg_nr = rech_kopf.sndg_nr GROUP BY knd_stamm.name1 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
H07-CAS: SELECT flghf.ort, SUM(sndg.fracht_gew_kg) AS total_cargo FROM flghf JOIN flug ON flghf.fh_nr = flug.urspr_fh JOIN sndg ON flug.flug_id = sndg.ladg_id GROUP BY flghf.ort ORDER BY total_cargo DESC LIMIT 5
H07-SCH: SELECT flghf.ort, SUM(sndg.ges_gew_kg / 1000) AS tonnage, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(sndg.ges_gew_kg / 1000) DESC) AS rank FROM flug_ladg JOIN flug ON flug_ladg.flug_id = flug.flug_id JOIN sndg ON flug_ladg.sndg_nr = sndg.sndg_nr JOIN flghf ON flug.urspr_fh = flghf(fh_nr) WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY flghf.ort ORDER BY tonnage DESC LIMIT 5
H07-BIZ: SELECT flghf.bez, SUM(sndg.fracht_gew_kg) AS outbound_tonnage FROM flghf JOIN flug ON flghf.fh_nr = flug.urspr_fh JOIN sndg ON flug.flug_id = flug_ladg.flug_id WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY flghf.fh_nr ORDER BY outbound_tonnage DESC LIMIT 5
H07-VAG: SELECT flghf.bez, COUNT(zoll_anm.anm_id) AS export_count FROM flghf JOIN zoll_anm ON flghf.fh_nr = zoll_anm.fh_nr WHERE zoll_anm.anm_art = 'export' GROUP BY flghf.fh_nr ORDER BY export_count DESC LIMIT 10
H08-CAS: SELECT lfz_typ.mdl, COUNT(*) AS completed_flights_more_than_half_full FROM lfz JOIN lfz_typ ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr JOIN flug_ladg ON flug.flug_id = flug_ladg.flug_id WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' AND flug_ladg.abschn_stat = 'flown' AND flug_ladg.ges_vol_m3 * 1000 > lfz_typ.max_vol_m3 * 0.5 GROUP BY lfz_typ.mdl
H08-SCH: SELECT lfz_typ.mdl, SUM(flug_ladg.ges_vol_m3) AS total_vol, COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS completed_flights FROM lfz_typ JOIN lfz ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr JOIN flug_ladg ON flug_ladg.lfz_nr = lfz.lfz_nr JOIN flug ON flug_ladg.flug_id = flug.flug_id WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY lfz_typ.mdl HAVING total_vol > 0.5 * lfz_typ.max_vol_m3
H08-BIZ: SELECT lfz_typ.mdl, COUNT(*) AS completed_flights FROM lfz JOIN lfz_typ ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY lfz_typ.mdl HAVING SUM(lfz.max_vol_m3 * lfz.max_nutzl_kg / (lfz.max_vol_m3 * lfz.max_nutzl_kg + lfz.max_vol_m3 * lfz.max_nutzl_kg * 0.5)) > 50
H08-VAG: SELECT lft.mdl FROM lfz lft JOIN lfz_typ lftyp ON lft.typ_nr = lftyp.typ_nr WHERE lft.ges_flugstd BETWEEN lftyp.max_nutzl_kg / 2 AND lftyp.max_nutzl_kg
H09-CAS: SELECT lfz_nr FROM lfz WHERE heimat_fh_nr IN (SELECT fh_nr FROM flghf WHERE hub_kz = 1) GROUP BY lfz_nr HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT heimat_fh_nr) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flghf WHERE hub_kz = 1)
H09-SCH: SELECT kennz FROM lfz WHERE lfz_nr IN (SELECT flug_id FROM flug WHERE abfl_fh IN (SELECT fh_nr FROM flghf WHERE hub_kz = 1) AND stat = 'completed') GROUP BY kennz HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT abfl_fh) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flghf WHERE hub_kz = 1)
H09-BIZ: SELECT DISTINCT lfz.kennz FROM lfz JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' AND lfz.heimat_fh_nr IN (SELECT fh_nr FROM flghf WHERE hub_kz = 1)
H09-VAG: SELECT DISTINCT lfz.kennz FROM lfz JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr
H10-CAS: SELECT zoll_land, COUNT(*) AS freq FROM zoll_anm WHERE (zollwert_usd * (zollsatz_pct + eust_usd / zollwert_usd)) / zollwert_usd > 0.2 GROUP BY zoll_land
H10-SCH: SELECT zoll_land, COUNT(*) AS import_count FROM zoll_anm WHERE anm_art = 'import' AND (zoll_betr_usd + eust_usd) > 0.2 * zollwert_usd GROUP BY zoll_land
H10-BIZ: SELECT zolltarif_nr, COUNT(*) FROM zoll_anm WHERE zollsatz_pct > 20 GROUP BY zolltarif_nr
H10-VAG: SELECT zoll_land FROM zoll_anm WHERE zollsatz_pct > 20 ORDER BY zollsatz_pct DESC LIMIT 10
